BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那是村长绵！好多绵绵在围观，发生什么事了吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That's Elder Fuzzy! There are so many Fuzzies crowding around… I wonder what happened?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是勇者大人！勇者大人们回来了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's the adventurers! They have returned!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 回到了沃伦大陆，这里的一切都没有变……吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You're back to the Warren Continent. Has nothing… changed?

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the outer ring of the <blue>Crimson Castle</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往龙堡附近的最后目击地点搜寻馋馋绵。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go near the Crimson Castle to find the sighting location and look for the Glutton Fuzzy.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里就是村长绵标记的地点了，似乎没有看到馋馋绵呢~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So this is the spot Elder Fuzzy marked. Looks like Glutton Fuzzy isn't here.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 地上似乎是一些遗落的物品？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Looks like someone dropped a few things over here.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 检查四周的痕迹，搜寻跟馋馋绵相关的线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Examine the traces around and search for clues related to the Glutton Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据好斗绵的说法，馋馋绵逃往了营地方向。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Brawly Fuzzy said that the Glutton Fuzzy ran towards the direction of the camp.

Description.LocalizedString: Find a Fuzzy that knows something

PanelDescription.SourceString: 营地中似乎没有馋馋绵的踪迹，在附近看看有没有知情的绵吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are no traces of the Glutton Fuzzy in the camp. Look around to see if there are any Fuzzies who know something.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 失主绵可能知情？去问问绵有没有看到过馋馋绵吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Maybe the Item-Lost Fuzzy knows something? Go ask if they've seen the Glutton Fuzzy.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据失主绵的说法，馋馋绵向绵绵村跑去了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Item-Lost Fuzzy said that the Glutton Fuzzy went to the Fuzzy Village.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就算难过也不能哭，眼泪会把身子融化的！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Even if you're sad—don't cry! You'll melt!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 身子被融化了就会消失，绵不希望你消失……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If your body melts away, you'll disappear entirely. This Fuzzy doesn't want you to go away forever…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这段对话似乎在哪里听到过呢……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I have a massive sense of déjà vu right now…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在村口发现了馋馋绵，不过馋馋绵看起来有点……难过？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You found the Glutton Fuzzy at the entrance of the village, buy they look a bit… sad?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 既然馋馋绵已经找到了，不如去问问村长吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Since you already found the Glutton Fuzzy, you should go ask the elder.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Key is Hard to Stomach

Description.LocalizedString: Check the <blue>recipe for the magical key</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 馋馋绵哭晕过去了，先看看馋馋绵留下的配方吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Glutton Fuzzy fainted from crying. Go check out the recipe they left.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Key is Hard to Stomach

PanelDescription.SourceString: 矮人绵突然出现，它可能会知道什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Dwarf Fuzzy suddenly appears. Maybe they know something?

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Key is Hard to Stomach

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到艺术绵询问有关「艺术的造物」的线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the Art Fuzzy and ask about clues for the "Artistic Creation."

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Key is Hard to Stomach

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到神秘商绵询问有关「蓬松松生发膏」的线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant and ask about clues for the Cloudcoat Growth Salve.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 传来着急的绵绵的声音，发生什么了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You hear the sounds of a Fuzzy hurrying. What's going on?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 馋馋绵似乎醒过来了？问问着急的绵绵发生了什么事情吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Did the Glutton Fuzzy just wake up? Ask the Hurrying Fuzzy about what happened.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据村长绵的说法，维修绵似乎有办法。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: According to the Elder Fuzzy, the Maintenance Fuzzy seems to have a solution.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收集浮毛制作「融化的糖水」吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Collect Loose Fur to make Melted Sugar Water!

Description.SourceString: 获得<blue>「黏黏的光秃秃的树枝」</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 分别找到艺术绵、失主绵、神秘商绵获取造绵的材料吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the Art Fuzzy, Item-Lost Fuzzy, and Mysterious Fuzzy Merchant to find materials for Fuzzy creation!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前去小树林跟众人集合，开始造绵吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the woods to assemble with the others and start creating a Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 材料收集齐全，去告诉维修绵一切准备就绪。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've collected the materials. Go tell the Maintenance Fuzzy to get ready.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切准备就绪，开始绵体炼成吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The preparations are complete. Begin creating a Fuzzy!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 炼成成功……了吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Was the attempt a… success?

Description.SourceString: 与英雄小屋的神秘绵交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the Enigma Fuzzy at the Heroine's residence.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据残卷中的线索，似乎可以找到英雄小屋那里的神秘绵补全设定？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The clues from the incomplete manuscript seem to point to the Heroine's Hut. That should be where you can find the Enigma Fuzzy's complete design documents.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 债主绵好像收不回债了，去帮帮它吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Lender Fuzzy isn't interested in collecting debt anymore. Go help them.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到欠债的绵们，劝它们回村吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the Debtor Fuzzies and persuade them to return to the village.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

Description.LocalizedString: Go back and find the <blue>Lender Fuzzy</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 告诉债主绵，你已经把欠债的绵绵带回来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tell the Lender Fuzzy that you have brought back the Debtor Fuzzies.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 债主绵发生了变化。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A change occurs to the Lender Fuzzy.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来……这才是绵不需要收回金币的真相！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: And that… is why the Fuzzy wasn't asking for the Gold Coins back!

QuestName.LocalizedString: Are Gold Coins really more important than… anything?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 升级后的地主绵，非常慷慨。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The leveled-up Landlord Fuzzy is extremely generous.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 菇绵们好像在争吵，上前问问吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Fungi Fuzzies are arguing with each other. Go and ask them what it's about…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收集绵们需要的菇。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Collect the fungi the Fuzzies asked for.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 绵们给你准备了物资作为谢礼，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Fuzzies prepared some supplies to thank you. Go take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 绵们给你准备了物资作为谢礼，去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Fuzzies prepared some supplies to thank you. Go take a look.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Beat On, the Heart of Summer!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 星沉湾沙滩上正在举行排球比赛，过去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A volleyball competition is being held at Starfall Bay. Go take a look.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Beat On, the Heart of Summer!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向龙叔打听比赛相关事宜。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask Uncle Loong about the competition

PanelDescription.SourceString: 薄荷好像正在为某件事苦恼……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Something is bothering Mint…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在沙滩等待薄荷。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait for Mint at the beach.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和薄荷一起组队吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Team up with Mint!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在正式参赛之前，龙叔似乎还有其他的安排……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Uncle Loong seems to have another plan before the competition begins…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在热身赛中取得胜利。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Win the warm-up match.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看起来龙叔对你们的表现相当满意……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Uncle Loong seems pleased with your performance…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去浮冰影院和黑羽会合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet Blackbird at the Floe Cinema.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与黑羽聊聊今天要看的电影吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to Blackbird about what movie to watch today.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 带黑羽去抽风猫奶茶店。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take Blackbird to Crazy Cat.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 给自己和黑羽分别买一杯奶茶。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Buy two milk teas, one for you and one for Blackbird.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去「菲林轨迹」照相馆与黑羽会合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet Blackbird at the Film Orbit Studio.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向黑羽打听一下今日的委托内容。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask Blackbird about today's commission.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 进入照相馆内。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Enter the Photo Studio.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 听照相馆老板聊聊具体的委托事项。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to the Photo Studio Owner to learn the details of the commission.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Second Floor of the Photo Studio</>
Go to the <blue>Second Floor of the Photo Studio</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往照相馆二楼。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to the second floor of the Photo Studio.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与黑羽四处看看照相馆现有的布景。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Look around the existing backdrops in the Photo Studio with Blackbird.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 黑羽似乎对改造后的布景很满意……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Blackbird seems quite satisfied with the remodeled backdrop…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托圆满完成，是时候离开了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The commission is complete. It's time to leave.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在照相馆外和黑羽聊聊。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to Blackbird outside the Photo Studio.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 黑羽似乎有事找你？去魔女之家看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Blackbird might need you for something. Why not check out The Witch's House?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和黑羽聊聊她的收藏。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Talk to Blackbird about her collection.

PanelDescription.SourceString: #隐藏任务#礼物选鎏金盏
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: #Hidden Quest# Reward Choice: Gold Gilded Cup

PanelDescription.SourceString: #隐藏任务#礼物选宝石
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: #Hidden Quest# Reward Choice: Gem

PanelDescription.SourceString: #隐藏任务#礼物选木鸟
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: #Hidden Quest# Reward Choice: Wooden Bird
